items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Joseph C. Smith. "There Are Smiles That Make You Happy." No saxophone, he just had strings in his orchestra and I think he played in the Waldorf.

ctx.x: What were the things that you liked.

Well, at that time, there was Whiteman at that time, but there was a lot of -- the Original Dixieland Jazz Band. I listened to a lot of that. Joseph C. Smith. "There Are Smiles That Make You Happy." No saxophone, he just had strings in his orchestra and I think he played in the Waldorf.
I guess the Original Dixieland Jazz Band was 1917.
